meta.description: A marketing card whose lower half is a halftone field with a comet swept through it — the cone is a void carved out of the dots, not a shape drawn over them. One signed-distance function decides both which dots are removed and which are feathered at the edge, and three OKLCH shades bucketed by distance from the wake give the flat grid depth. Generated deterministically at module scope, so server and client draw the identical card.
